page.overview:
Who is Anche?

During "" , will ask to talk to about obtaining for drink. When the situation is explained, will allow to bring the to . She reminds him to move quickly due to the heat, since can not do anything with . will be diappointed if the melts, though she accepts 's mistake and allows him to take another block.

After completing the , speaking to will cause her to ask to once again deliver to for her. While she usually delivers the herself, she explains that the nearby monsters are preventing her from leaving the . charges 50 for the and explains that will reimburse him. Once has paid the fee, the will begin. is timed while delivering the and will be rewarded with extra if he delivers it quickly enough. If accepts the task, expresses joy and reiterates that will be waiting for him at the end of the nearby ruins.

If attempts to melt a formation of inside the or if detects any inside the , will scold him for damaging her supply before kicking him out. If detects but cannot find the culprit (such as if sets the while she is asleep and then leaves), she will angrily ask who is responsible for putting it there. If is caught enough times, she will inform that she will not be held responsible for the punishment being brought to him and demands that he leave.
